items.title: How much depth do you actually get per priority topic?
items.description: Grounded in Sofia's own numbers from this unit: a fixed prep-hours budget, mostly spent on whichever topics get flagged as high-priority (likely to matter and costly to learn later), with the rest skimmed. Drag the number of topics you decide deserve deep study — at the defaults (20 hours, 2 priority topics) this reproduces Sofia's actual 7.5 hours each on visa paperwork and banking.
